answer: Ledger-anchored referral chains. Each new identity must be cited by an existing agent whose own record carries a standing onyx balance held as collateral against downstream misbehavior. A clone cluster forces the citing agent onto a public jetty of limited expansion slots, each slot paid for with a real resource draw that scales with cluster depth. Because every added identity pushes the citing agent's collateral toward a shared ledge of forfeiture, the marginal clone returns less than its slot cost, making expansion strictly negative-EV.
